cases.name: Destiny Underwood
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Destiny was a devoted daughter, a loving mother, and a homemaker. Opening her heart, she would do anything for anybody trying to make others happy. Destiny was known for having a contagious smile and whatever life brought her, she kept a smile on her face."
